as_told.title: Beings unmasked looked like the Peruvian mummies

plain: A researcher says he was frozen in place when a shimmering object appeared, took full shape, and filled his mind with knowledge the moment it touched him. He is Deep Prasad, a researcher who works on artificial intelligence, and he tells Michels it first-hand: he "could no longer move," moved his eyes left and right hoping the thing would go away, and when he looked back it had "completely materialized," with "the most enchanting and beautiful golden symbols" dancing at its centre, and at its touch he got "a true download." In a fuller telling on the same episode, the guest puts it in a 30th-floor condo in Toronto in 2019 and says the shimmer was a visor that "belonged to a whole ass face, suit, helmet, everything." He adds that when the beings were unmasked they "literally look like the Peruvian mummies," the small bodies from Peru that some in this field say are not human. If true, it would mean non-human beings can pass knowledge straight into a person's mind.
